title: Companion Plants Attract Beneficial Insects
reason: Describes various companion planting strategies for attracting beneficial insects.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of companion planting for attracting beneficial insects.

subtasks.text: Describe how borage can attract bees and help pollinate vegetables.
Explain how basil, when allowed to flower, provides a food source for beneficial insects.
Mention that dill helps deter hornworms when planted near tomatoes.

tasks.task: Describe how certain flowers can attract pollinators and beneficial insects.

subtasks.text: Focus on how dwarf cosmos can be used as a companion plant under taller vegetables due to their low growth and attractive colors.
Explain the role of French marigolds in natural pest deterrents, specifically highlighting their low growth and blooms.
Note that French marigolds are less attractive to Japanese beetles compared to other varieties.
